countries.name: Argentina

beginner.casey: Oh no! Foxy snuck off to dance the Tango! Use the clues to find which country Foxy is in!

clues.t: People here do a beautiful dance called the Tango!
Soccer is the favourite sport here and they have won the World Cup!
The flag here is light blue and white with a bright sun in the middle!

intermediate.casey: Foxy ran off to a South American country where the flag is blue and white and a famous dance was born!

clues.t: The Tango dance was invented here and started in the capital city, Buenos Aires!
This country has won the FIFA World Cup and is amazing at football!
People here love to eat beef and have big barbecues called asados!

advanced.casey: Foxy is in a South American country whose capital means 'fair winds' in Spanish and gave the world the Tango!

clues.t: Buenos Aires is one of South America's largest cities, packed with European-style architecture and lively tango clubs!
The Tango is now a UNESCO World Cultural Heritage dance, performed in dedicated tango clubs called milongas found all across the capital!
This is the 8th largest country in the world and shares the Andes mountains with its neighbour to the west!

countries.fact: Argentina is the birthplace of the Tango! Capital: Buenos Aires, which means 'fair winds'. They have also won the World Cup! 💃

countries.name: Australia

beginner.casey: Foxy hopped away to a faraway country where animals carry their babies in a pocket!

clues.t: Kangaroos live here and carry babies in a pouch!
Fluffy koalas sleep in eucalyptus trees here!
Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff played tennis in Melbourne in this country!

intermediate.casey: Foxy went down under to a huge country where kangaroos are the only ones of their kind on Earth!

clues.t: Kangaroos only live in this country. You will not find them wild anywhere else!
A famous tennis tournament called the Australian Open is held in Melbourne here!
The Great Barrier Reef, the world's biggest coral reef, is found here!

advanced.casey: Foxy is in the country whose capital is Canberra, but whose biggest city is Sydney, not the capital!

clues.t: Canberra was purpose-built as the capital, chosen as a compromise between rivals Sydney and Melbourne, who both wanted the title!
Kangaroos only exist here and there are actually more kangaroos than people in this country!
Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff played tennis in Melbourne at the famous Australian Open!

countries.fact: Kangaroos only exist in Australia! Capital: Canberra. Home of the Great Barrier Reef and the Melbourne tennis Open! 🦘

countries.name: Barbados

beginner.casey: Foxy swam to a tiny sunny island where Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff went fishing for a very special jumping fish!

clues.t: The national symbol of this island is a fish that can leap and glide through the air!
This is a beautiful Caribbean island surrounded by warm turquoise water!
Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff went fishing here in a place called Oistins!

intermediate.casey: Foxy is on a Caribbean island whose national symbol leaps right out of the sea and actually flies!

clues.t: The flying fish is the national symbol of this small Caribbean island!
This island was ruled by England for a very long time before becoming fully independent!
The world-famous singer Rihanna was born and grew up on this island!

advanced.casey: Foxy is in a Caribbean island nation whose capital is Bridgetown and whose national symbol soars through the air!

clues.t: The capital city is Bridgetown, one of the oldest cities built by Europeans in the Americas!
The flying fish is the national symbol and appears on stamps, money, and the coat of arms!
This island made history in 2021 by removing the monarchy and becoming a fully independent republic!

countries.fact: Barbados is a Caribbean island whose national symbol is the flying fish! Capital: Bridgetown. Rihanna is from here! 🐟

countries.name: France

beginner.casey: Foxy floated up in a hot air balloon near a very tall iron tower. Bonjour means hello here!

clues.t: There is a very tall tower made of iron here that is famous around the world!
People here eat yummy crescent-shaped bread called croissants for breakfast!
Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff rode a hot air balloon near the famous iron tower here!

intermediate.casey: Foxy said bonjour and is hiding near the most famous iron tower on Earth, in a city known as the City of Light!

clues.t: The Eiffel Tower in Paris is one of the most visited places in the whole world!
This country makes over 1,500 types of cheese, more than any other country on Earth!
This country is famous for amazing art. One museum here holds the Mona Lisa!

advanced.casey: Foxy is in the City of Light, a European country whose capital makes over 1,500 types of cheese and where bonjour is hello!

clues.t: Paris was founded over 2,000 years ago and welcomes around 40 million tourists a year, more than almost any city on Earth!
This country invented croissants, baguettes, and crème brûlée, and has strict laws protecting how its traditional foods must be made!
The Eiffel Tower was built in 1889 as a temporary structure, but people loved it so much they kept it!

countries.fact: France has the Eiffel Tower in Paris and produces over 1,500 types of cheese! Capital: Paris, the City of Light! 🗼

countries.name: Ghana

beginner.casey: Foxy went to a colourful jewellery market in West Africa, the first country on its continent to be free!

clues.t: This flag has red, gold, and green stripes with a black star in the middle!
Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff visited a colourful jewellery market here in a city called Accra!
This country in West Africa was the very first in Africa to gain independence!

intermediate.casey: Foxy is in Accra, the capital of the very first African country to gain independence from colonial rule!

clues.t: When this country gained independence in 1957, it inspired dozens of other African nations to fight for their own freedom!
A popular song and dance called the Azonto comes from here and is so much fun!
This country is famous for colourful Kente cloth worn at celebrations!

advanced.casey: Foxy is in a West African capital called Accra, home of Kente cloth, the Azonto dance, and some of the world's finest cocoa!

clues.t: The capital is Accra. Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff visited its famous colourful jewellery market!
The Azonto spread from this country all over Africa and the world!
This country is one of the world's biggest producers of cocoa, the main ingredient in chocolate!

countries.fact: Ghana was the first African country to gain independence! Capital: Accra, famous for the Azonto dance and Kente cloth! 🌍

countries.name: Indonesia

beginner.casey: Foxy sailed to a country made of thousands of islands. Jaime's friend Bima the illustrator lives there!

clues.t: This country is made up of thousands and thousands of islands, more than any other!
Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff visited their friend Bima in Bali and did drawings together!
A musical instrument called a gamelan is played here and sounds a bit like a xylophone!

intermediate.casey: Foxy sailed to the largest island country on Earth, made of over 17,000 islands, including beautiful Bali!

clues.t: The islands here stretch so far from east to west that they span roughly the same width as the entire United States!
The gamelan is a traditional instrument here and makes a magical sound with bells and drums!
This is the 4th most populated country in the world with over 270 million people!

advanced.casey: Foxy is in a Southeast Asian country whose capital is Jakarta, with over 17,000 islands and the world's largest lizard!

clues.t: The capital is Jakarta, though this country is moving its capital to a new city called Nusantara!
The islands here span three time zones and are home to more than 700 distinct languages spoken across the archipelago!
Komodo dragons can grow up to 3 metres long and have venomous bites. They live only on a handful of islands here!

countries.fact: Indonesia is made up of over 17,000 islands! Bima the illustrator is from here! Capital: Jakarta! 🏝️

countries.name: Italy

beginner.casey: Foxy is hiding near a wobbly tower that doesn't stand straight, and ciao means hello here!

clues.t: Pizza was invented in this country. Yummy!
There is a famous tower here that leans sideways instead of standing straight up!
Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff sang near a giant old arena called the Colosseum here!

intermediate.casey: Foxy is in the country where pasta was invented, and where a famous tower stands crooked. Ciao means hello here!

clues.t: The capital is Rome, and this country has over 600 different pasta shapes, each traditionally paired with its own specific sauce!
The Leaning Tower of Pisa started leaning because the ground underneath was too soft!
The Colosseum in Rome is nearly 2,000 years old and once held 80,000 people!

advanced.casey: Foxy is in the Eternal City, a European country that gave the world pasta, pizza, and the Roman Empire!

clues.t: Rome has been continuously inhabited for over 2,800 years, built on seven hills, with ancient ruins scattered throughout the city!
This country has over 600 different pasta shapes, and Italians have firm rules about which sauce goes with which pasta!
This country has more UNESCO World Heritage Sites than any other country in the world!

countries.fact: Italy is the birthplace of pasta! Capital: Rome, the Eternal City. Home to the Leaning Tower of Pisa! 🍕

countries.name: Jamaica

beginner.casey: Foxy is on a sunny Caribbean island where Jaime tried a yummy spicy chicken dish called Jerk Chicken!

clues.t: Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff ate spicy Jerk Chicken here. It smells amazing on the grill!
The flag here has a big X shape with black, gold, and green colours!
A kind of music called Reggae was born on this island and has a great bouncy beat!

intermediate.casey: Foxy is on the island where Reggae music was born and the world's fastest man grew up!

clues.t: Bob Marley, one of the best-selling music artists in history, grew up on this island and brought Reggae to the entire world!
Jerk Chicken is the most famous food here, cooked on a grill with spicy island seasonings!
Usain Bolt set the 100m world record of 9.58 seconds in 2009, the fastest any human has ever sprinted!

advanced.casey: Foxy is in Kingston, the capital of the island that gave the world Reggae, Bob Marley, and Usain Bolt!

clues.t: The capital is Kingston, the largest city and cultural heart of this Caribbean island!
Reggae grew out of Kingston's lively downtown music scene in the 1960s and now influences music styles all around the world!
This tiny island has produced more Olympic and World Championship sprint champions per capita than any other nation on Earth!

countries.fact: Jamaica is the birthplace of Reggae music and Bob Marley! Capital: Kingston. Famous for Jerk Chicken! 🎵

countries.name: Japan

beginner.casey: Foxy is hiding at a sushi restaurant in a country where it is actually polite to slurp your noodles really loud!

clues.t: Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff ate sushi here while the chef diced fresh fish at the counter!
Beautiful pink cherry blossom trees bloom here every spring!
There is a tall snowy volcano here shaped like a perfect triangle. It is very famous!

intermediate.casey: Foxy is in an island country where sushi was invented and it is polite to slurp your noodles!

clues.t: It is polite to slurp your noodles here. The louder, the better!
Cherry blossom season here is so beautiful that people picnic under the pink trees!
This country is one of the world's leaders in robots and amazing technology!

advanced.casey: Foxy is in Tokyo, the most populated city in the entire world, where slurping noodles is the polite thing to do!

clues.t: Tokyo's greater metro area is home to over 37 million people and has more Michelin-starred restaurants than any other city on Earth!
This country pioneered the bullet train, the Sony Walkman, and industrial robots, changing everyday life all over the world!
This country is made up of about 6,800 islands and sits on the Pacific Ring of Fire!

countries.fact: In this country it is polite to slurp your noodles! Capital: Tokyo, the most populated city in the world! 🍜

countries.name: Kenya

beginner.casey: Foxy went on safari in Africa where Elefante met a real elephant, the biggest land animal on Earth!

clues.t: Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff went on safari and saw real elephants here at the Masai Mara!
Lions, elephants, zebras, and giraffes all roam the wide grasslands here!
The Masai Mara is a famous wildlife park here where the Great Migration happens!

intermediate.casey: Foxy is at the Masai Mara, an East African country home to 36,000 elephants and the world's fastest runners!

clues.t: This country is home to an incredible 36,000 elephants!
This country has some of the world's greatest long-distance runners, including many Olympic champions!
The Masai Mara is this country's most famous wildlife reserve and home to the Great Migration!

advanced.casey: Foxy is in Nairobi, the capital of an East African country with 36,000 elephants and world-record runners!

clues.t: The capital Nairobi is the only city in the world with a national game park right on its outskirts, where lions and giraffes roam!
The Masai Mara hosts the Great Migration, with over 2 million wildebeest crossing the Mara River every year!
Runners from this country have dominated marathons and long-distance races for decades!

countries.fact: This country has 36,000 elephants and the world's greatest long-distance runners! Capital: Nairobi, home of the Masai Mara! 🐘

countries.name: Mexico

beginner.casey: Foxy went to a fiesta in Tulum where Jaime played guitar with mariachi musicians wearing big colourful hats!

clues.t: Yummy tacos and tortillas were invented in this country!
Jaime played mariachi music in Tulum. Musicians here wear big colourful hats called sombreros!
The flag here is green, white, and red with an eagle sitting on a cactus in the middle!

intermediate.casey: Foxy is in a North American country where the world's largest pyramid stands and mariachi music fills the air!

clues.t: The Great Pyramid of Cholula is so huge and overgrown that it looks like a natural hill, with a church built right on top of it!
Mariachi music comes from here, with trumpets, violins, and guitars!
Day of the Dead is a beautiful celebration here to remember and honour loved ones!

advanced.casey: Foxy is in one of the largest capital cities in North America, and the world's biggest pyramid is nearby in Cholula!

clues.t: The capital, Mexico City, was built directly on top of the ancient Aztec city of Tenochtitlan, and parts of it still exist underground!
The Great Pyramid of Cholula is bigger than Egypt's pyramids by volume, but looks like a grassy hill with a church on top!
This country is home to over half of all cactus species in the world!

countries.fact: This country has the world's largest pyramid in Cholula! Capital: Mexico City. Famous for mariachi and tacos! 🌮

countries.name: Nepal

beginner.casey: Foxy climbed all the way up to the tallest mountain in the whole world, higher than any plane flies!

clues.t: The tallest mountain in the world, Mount Everest, is in this country!
Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff wore orange hiking suits to climb the snowy mountain here!
This country has the only national flag in the world that is not a rectangle. It looks like two triangles stacked up!

intermediate.casey: Foxy is at the top of Mount Everest, 8,848 metres above sea level in an Asian country whose flag is not rectangular!

clues.t: Mount Everest is 8,848 metres tall and about 60 million years old!
The flag's double-pennant shape represents two Himalayan peaks, with a white moon at the top and a white sun below!
This is the birthplace of Buddha, one of the world's most important religious figures!

advanced.casey: Foxy is in Kathmandu, the capital of a small Asian country with the world's only non-rectangular flag and its tallest mountain!

clues.t: The capital Kathmandu sits in a valley surrounded by snow-capped peaks and is home to seven UNESCO World Heritage Sites!
The flag's two pennant shapes represent the Himalayan peaks. It is the only non-rectangular national flag in the world!
This country has 8 of the world's 10 highest mountains, including Everest, Kangchenjunga, and Lhotse!

countries.fact: Mount Everest is here, 8,848 metres tall and 60 million years old! Capital: Kathmandu. Only non-rectangular national flag! 🏔️

countries.name: Peru

beginner.casey: Foxy hiked up to a secret ancient city built high in the clouds in South America!

clues.t: Fluffy animals called llamas and alpacas live in the mountains here!
There is a magical lost city called Machu Picchu built high in the mountains here!
Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff played pan flutes here, long pipes that make a beautiful echoing sound!

intermediate.casey: Foxy is at Machu Picchu, a lost city 2,430 metres above sea level in a South American country!

clues.t: Machu Picchu sits an incredible 2,430 metres above sea level!
Llamas were used for thousands of years in this country as pack animals to carry heavy loads!
The Amazon River, the world's largest river by water flow, begins in this country!

advanced.casey: Foxy is in Lima, the capital of a South American country where Machu Picchu stands 2,430 metres above sea level!

clues.t: The capital Lima is home to nearly a third of the country's population and is one of South America's top food destinations!
Machu Picchu was built by the Inca Empire around 1450 and then mysteriously abandoned 100 years later!
Potatoes, tomatoes, and quinoa were all originally grown here and are now eaten all around the world!

countries.fact: Machu Picchu is here, 2,430 metres above sea level! Capital: Lima. Home of llamas and pan flutes! 🦙

countries.name: South Africa

beginner.casey: Foxy found penguins living on a sunny African beach. This amazing country even has three capitals!

clues.t: Penguins actually live on the beach here in Africa. Surprise!
This country is called the Rainbow Nation because of all its wonderful different people!
Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff sailed around and spotted penguins in Cape Town!

intermediate.casey: Foxy is in the only country in the world with three capital cities, and penguins on its beaches!

clues.t: This country has three capitals: Bloemfontein, Cape Town, and Pretoria!
African penguins live on the beaches here and are the only penguin species found in Africa!
You can see the Big Five on safari here: lion, elephant, rhino, leopard, and buffalo!

advanced.casey: Foxy is in the southernmost country of Africa, the only nation with three capitals: Bloemfontein, Cape Town, and Pretoria!

clues.t: The three capitals serve different roles: Pretoria handles the executive, Cape Town holds parliament, and Bloemfontein houses the Supreme Court!
This country is one of the world's top producers of gold and diamonds!
Rugby is massive here, and the Springboks have won multiple Rugby World Cup championships!

countries.fact: This country has three capitals: Bloemfontein, Cape Town, and Pretoria. Penguins live on its beaches! 🐧

countries.name: South Korea

beginner.casey: Foxy tried on a funny mask in an Asian country where kids go crazy for K-Pop music!

clues.t: Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff tried on lots of fun traditional masks here!
K-Pop is the most popular kind of music in this country. So catchy!
Spicy kimchi, fermented cabbage, is eaten with almost every meal here!

intermediate.casey: Foxy is in an East Asian country where K-Pop rules the charts, kimchi is on every table, and Samsung was founded!

clues.t: K-Pop is the most popular genre of music here. BTS is from this country!
Traditional mask dances called Talchum are performed here, and the masks have funny expressions!
This country is one of the most technologically advanced in the world. Samsung was founded here!

advanced.casey: Foxy is in Seoul, the capital of an East Asian country where K-Pop is the biggest music genre and BTS was born!

clues.t: Seoul is one of the world's most connected cities, with some of the fastest average internet speeds on the planet!
Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff tried on traditional Talchum masks at a market here. The expressions were hilarious!
This country co-hosted the FIFA World Cup in 2002 and finished 4th, the best result ever for an Asian team!

countries.fact: This country is where K-Pop was born! Capital: Seoul. Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff tried on Talchum masks here! 🎭

countries.name: Spain

beginner.casey: Foxy said hola and got completely covered in flying tomatoes at the world's biggest food fight!

clues.t: Every August in a small town called Buñol, thousands of people throw tomatoes at each other in a giant, wonderfully messy festival!
Flamenco is a beautiful stomping dance from here with colourful dresses and stamping feet!
Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff visited the stunning Sagrada Familia church here, still being built since 1882!

intermediate.casey: Foxy is in a European country where the world's biggest food fight happens every year. Hola means hello here!

clues.t: La Tomatina takes place every August in the small town of Buñol, where 40,000 people throw over 100 tonnes of tomatoes!
Flamenco dancing originated in the south of this country with stomping feet and spinning skirts!
The Sagrada Familia in Barcelona has been under construction since 1882 and is still not finished!

advanced.casey: Foxy is in Madrid, the capital of a European country famous for La Tomatina, the biggest food fight on Earth!

clues.t: Madrid is one of Europe's highest capital cities and home to world-class art museums including the Prado and the Reina Sofía!
La Tomatina takes place in the town of Bunol, where 40,000 people throw 150,000 tomatoes in one hour!
This country won the FIFA World Cup in 2010 and has won the UEFA European Championship 4 times, a record!

countries.fact: This country has La Tomatina, the world's biggest food fight! Capital: Madrid. Flamenco dancing is from here! 🍅

countries.name: Sri Lanka

beginner.casey: Foxy went to a colourful spice market on a teardrop-shaped island near the tip of India!

clues.t: Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff visited a market bursting with yummy spices here. The smells were amazing!
Elephants are very special here and parade through colourful festivals!
Elefante played a sitar here, a beautiful stringed instrument from this part of the world!

intermediate.casey: Foxy is on a teardrop-shaped Asian island nation with two capital cities and amazing spice markets!

clues.t: This country has two capitals: Colombo and Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte!
This is one of the biggest producers of tea in the world. The tea is called Ceylon tea!
The elephant is the national animal here and appears in many traditional festivals and parades!

advanced.casey: Foxy is on a teardrop-shaped island with two capitals: Colombo and Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte!

clues.t: Colombo is the busy commercial port capital, while Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte serves as the official legislative capital just 9 km away!
This country is the world's 4th largest tea producer. The tea is called Ceylon tea!
The flag here features a golden lion holding a sword, one of the most striking national flags in the world!

countries.fact: This country has two capitals: Colombo and Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte! Famous for spices and Ceylon tea! 🌶️

countries.name: Switzerland

beginner.casey: Foxy went skiing on snowy mountains and ate melted cheese from a big bubbling pot!

clues.t: Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff went skiing on the beautiful snowy Alps mountains here!
Fondue, melted cheese in a pot for dipping bread, is the most famous food from here!
This flag is red with a white cross in the middle, one of the most recognisable flags in the world!

intermediate.casey: Foxy is in a European country where the alphorn is blown to soothe cattle and the skiing is incredible!

clues.t: The alphorn is a very long wooden instrument traditionally blown here to soothe cattle!
This country is famous for cheese fondue and chocolate, two of the world's greatest foods!
The watches made in this country are the most famous in the world and have been crafted here for hundreds of years!

advanced.casey: Foxy is in Bern, the capital of a tiny European country known for neutrality, chocolate, and an alphorn that soothes cows!

clues.t: Bern has been the capital since 1848, and its medieval old town with kilometres of covered stone arcades is a UNESCO World Heritage Site!
This country is home to many international organisations, including the Red Cross, whose flag is the reverse of this flag!
This country is famous for its banks, watches, chocolate, and for being officially neutral in wars!

countries.fact: The alphorn is traditionally blown here to soothe cattle! Capital: Bern. Famous for fondue, chocolate, and skiing! ⛷️

countries.name: United Kingdom

beginner.casey: Foxy went to see the red royal guards standing very still in front of a famous palace!

clues.t: Tall guards wearing big black furry hats stand very still outside the palace here!
Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff visited a famous old tower and a drawbridge here, the Tower of London and Tower Bridge!
This country has a King and the Royal Family. They wave from palace balconies!

intermediate.casey: Foxy is in a country that is actually four countries in one, including England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland!

clues.t: Each of the four nations has its own distinct culture, language heritage, and separate national sports teams that compete internationally!
The Tower of London is over 900 years old and was once a prison for royalty!
The Beatles, the Rolling Stones, and Adele all came from here. It is a music superpower!

advanced.casey: Foxy is in London, the capital of a country that includes England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland!

clues.t: London was founded by the Romans as 'Londinium' in 43 AD and has been one of the world's most important cities ever since!
The Tower of London has housed famous prisoners including Anne Boleyn and Guy Fawkes!
At its height, the empire built from this island nation was the largest in history, covering 26% of the world!

countries.fact: This country includes England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland! Capital: London, home of the Tower of London! 🏰

countries.name: USA

beginner.casey: Foxy played jazz music in New Orleans, a very lively city where this amazing music style was born!

clues.t: Jaime and Zany Dad Jeff played jazz music in New Orleans, the city where jazz was invented!
There is a giant green lady called the Statue of Liberty in a famous city called New York!
This flag has red and white stripes and a blue corner filled with white stars!

intermediate.casey: Foxy is in a huge country where New Orleans is the birthplace of jazz, and the first to land on the Moon!

clues.t: New Orleans jazz was born when African rhythms, blues, and European musical styles blended together in the city's vibrant streets!
Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed on the Moon in 1969, watched live on TV by around 600 million people worldwide!
This country has 50 states, from frozen Alaska all the way to tropical Hawaii!

advanced.casey: Foxy is in Washington D.C., the capital of a 50-state country where New Orleans is the birthplace of jazz!

clues.t: Washington D.C. was purpose-built as the capital in 1790, designed in a grid layout and home to the White House and Congress!
This country is the world's third largest by area and the third most populated!
This country's space program has landed 12 humans on the Moon, starting with Neil Armstrong in 1969!

countries.fact: New Orleans is the birthplace of Jazz! Capital: Washington D.C. Home of the Statue of Liberty! 🎷
